headline: Stop the bleeding, prep for your weekend battle.
summary: You're gaining when you should lose 0.86kg weekly; TODAY demands Huel discipline and 45 minutes movement to reset momentum before Friday.
details: Stop emotional eating starting now—use Huel for lunch and dinner, avoid snacking impulses by planning your meals. Hit your treadmill or rowing machine for 45 minutes today to burn 1500+ kJ and break your gaining pattern. Wednesday matters because it sets the tone for Friday through Sunday when you historically sabotage yourself; a strong TODAY proves you can resist.
